description:
Diablo Immortal x StarCraft is live May 13 - and Blizzard is kicking off a community challenge 👀

Art, animation, or gameplay highlights - I want to see your take on this crossover. Here’s mine!

Post your entry using #DiabloImmortalxStarcraftChallenge - the challenge is live now and runs until May 25th at Midnight EST

And yes, one lucky winner will receive a custom-built Diablo Immortal x StarCraft PC 🔥

(Please check the Terms & Conditions linked in my bio for eligible entry countries and full challenge details) #DiabloImmortal #StarCraft #adventure https://docs.google.com/document/d/1FC6o0t6AmxTg7rSNP2_pBkB2C6wGqPr2D455jY6y5vg/edit?tab=t.0
